observations: Black motorcycle with protective plastic wrapping on the fuel tank, seat, and front forks.
A crown logo is visible on the headlight cowl, characteristic of the Royal brand.
The motorcycle is parked on a street next to a blue sedan.
Side panel has text that appears to be 'ROYAL' but is blurry.
The bike appears to be a standard commuter or 'okada' style model.

claims.evidence: Protective plastic is present, but the bike is outdoors on a street rather than in a showroom.
Engine displacement markings are not visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The engine may have mechanical issues or not start.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start and the engine running.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may be used despite the 'brand new' claim.
The engine capacity may be lower (e.g., 150cc) than claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the displacement stamp on the engine cylinder block.

risks.risk: Missing legal ownership or customs clearance papers.
risks.proof: Photos of the vehicle license and customs documentation.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the odometer reading.
Photo of the engine displacement stamp (cc) on the engine block.
Video of the motorcycle starting and idling.
Photos of the registration papers and customs clearance documents.
response.reason: A single low-resolution photo is insufficient to verify the 'brand new' claim or the engine capacity. For a vehicle, proof of functionality and legal documentation are essential for valuation.
